title:
The essential
features
intro: Organize your reading, shape your interface and take your feeds to every screen. FriRSS gives your FreshRSS installation a fresh perspective.

groups.title: Settle into your reading
groups.intro: Give every kind of feed the room it needs.

items.title: A layout for every feed
items.text: Three panes, two panes or a visual grid. Choose preview, standard or compact density, resize columns and adjust spacing.

items.title: The whole story
items.text: Retrieve full articles with Readability when a feed only includes a summary, images and videos included. Set the default globally or per feed. Extraction depends on the source website.

items.title: Keep the good ones
items.text: Favorites, read-later, categories and colored, nested labels keep your reading organized. Their counters show the total, the unread count or both; unread counts on labels need FreshRSS 1.26 or later. Search within the current view, including articles already read.

items.title: Stay on the keyboard
items.text: Open the command palette with ⌘K or Ctrl+K. Navigate feeds and actions with reassignable shortcuts and visible keyboard focus.

items.title: Video, when you press play
items.text: Supported YouTube embeds open from a thumbnail, on demand. Video requires an internet connection and loads from a third party.

items.title: Move at your own pace
items.text: Newest first, oldest first, or at random: rediscover articles in your current view. Choose how many articles to draw and how old they can be, then draw again whenever you like.

groups.label: Reading

groups.title: Take your reader everywhere
groups.intro: From a wide screen to a train with no signal.

items.title: A mobile PWA
items.text: Install the app from a supported browser. Swipe between articles, use touch actions and pull to refresh. PWA installation requires HTTPS outside localhost.

items.title: Read offline
items.text: Prepare the last 30 days of articles to read without a connection, images included. While it prepares, FriRSS estimates the time left, and you can cancel it. Pending actions and offline settings stay saved until you reconnect. Device storage limits still apply.

items.title: Pick up the thread
items.text: Resume your last feed and filters. On a shared device, each account and server keeps its own data; preferences sync across your devices.

groups.label: On the go

groups.title: Make it feel like you
groups.intro: Personalization goes beyond a light/dark switch.

items.title: Six starting points
items.text: Default, Riso, Paper and High Contrast in light; Night and Desk in dark. Follow your system appearance with your preferred pair.

items.title: Your own theme
items.text: Tune 38 colors and seven font sizes. Save, import, export and share themes. Set a custom app name and logo on your instance.

items.title: A grid sized your way
items.text: Set card width from 160 to 480 px, fill each row or keep a fixed width. Choose 16:9, 4:3, 3:4 or square images. On phones, the grid always fills the available width.

items.title: Toolbars your way
items.text: On computers, hide the buttons of the list bar and the reading pane one by one, or a whole bar. A hidden button stays in the command palette.

items.title: A list your way
items.text: Show or hide feed names, their icons and the date separators. Choose the action icons on each row: favorite, read later, open at source, mark as read.

items.title: Open on the right view
items.text: At launch, FriRSS goes back to the last view, or always opens All feeds or Unread. The server bar can be hidden too.

items.title: Ten languages
items.text: FriRSS speaks English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Ukrainian and Chinese. On first run it follows the browser’s language; change it in Preferences › General.

groups.label: Personalization

groups.title: AI, on your terms
groups.intro: Optional, off by default, and configured by an administrator.

items.title: Summaries and translations
items.text: Get a summary above an article, adjust its length, or translate the title and body into one of 28 languages. Switch back to the original at any time.

items.title: Choose the provider
items.text: Use Anthropic or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama and LM Studio. Choose models and per-feed or per-category behavior.

items.title: Know what leaves your server
items.text: Article text is sent to the selected provider. API keys are encrypted at rest and kept out of the browser. Admins control sharing and daily caps. Provider charges may apply.

groups.label: Optional AI

groups.title: Your servers. Your users.
groups.intro: One FriRSS installation can host multiple accounts and connect to multiple FreshRSS instances.

items.title: Accounts and single sign-on
items.text: Separate admin and user roles. Change your local password in preferences to sign out other sessions. Optional OIDC single sign-on links an existing account only after its owner confirms their password.

items.title: More than one FreshRSS
items.text: Switch FreshRSS instances from the top bar or command palette. Each server keeps its reading settings. Change its API password without removing it: FreshRSS checks the password before it is saved.

items.title: Docker, with room to grow
items.text: Official amd64 and arm64 images, persistent SQLite storage and encrypted backups. Redis is optional and strongly recommended for shared caching and prefetching.

groups.label: Hosting
